input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to plain SYCL 2020 in migrated/softmax.dp.cpp. No dpct helpers, DPCT macros or <dpct/...> includes remain, and it compiles with icpx -fsycl with add_dpct_include=false (0 warnings). Changes from the c2s output: sycl::nd_item<1> kernels; softMax2 uses a sub-group per slice with sycl::reduce_over_group (max and plus) and a grid-stride loop, so no sub-group size is hardcoded; sycl::exp instead of native::exp, which would have risked the 1e-6 tolerance; malloc_device/free on an in-order sycl::queue replaces dpct::dpct_free. Numerical check: a CPU expf reference (check/ref.cpp) against candidate output for kernel 1 and kernel 0 at 8192x256, 1000x100 and 37x7 gives max_abs_err 1.2e-7 or less, PASS at atol 1e-6. I did not run the original CUDA binary, so the reference is the CPU expf softmax with identical math, not the GPU output itself.
